prompt_preview:
Decide whether the proposal deck addresses the client requirement below.

STATUS (choose exactly one):
- "Covered": the slides commit to ALL parts of the requirement. Different wording is fine.
- "Partially covered": the slides commit to SOME parts, but at least one part is missing.
- "Not covered":

response.missing: Benchmarking the group's AI maturity against at least three regional and global logistics peers.
response.reasoning: The proposal includes an internal readiness assessment and capability diagnostic across the group's business units, but makes no mention of benchmarking AI maturity against peer logistics companies.
